audit.why: Levels 1-2 are Xerath's range war (Q 750 beam, W 1000, E 1050 vs her 800 Q), level 3+ flips on QE threat, late she is the pick threat vs his artillery — content layer already says this; the full-layer chart did not.
audit.corrected: Full-layer chart aligned to content and packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] has 3 entries, expected 4 — no entry for Xerath's R siege spike.
audit.why: Rite of the Arcane (5000 range, 130/115/100s CD) is his level-6+ identity and it is a channel her E cancels.

audit.whatIsWrong: The E-cancels-his-R-channel interaction appeared nowhere; breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; tradeBad referenced 'the dash' — Xerath has no dash.
audit.why: Kit: his R is flagged channel/interruptible, Shocking Orb 13-11s is his only CC, Eye of Destruction 14-10s. Syndra E is hard CC and cancels the channel.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries 13s/11s and 14-10s; E-cancels-R written into cooldowns, phases[6].why and spikes[3]; tradeBad rewritten around Shocking Orb.

edits.before: Q on every last-hit he takes — your level 1 poke is the best in the mage pool. Leave spheres on the ground; they're ammo.
edits.after: Arcanopulse out-ranges your Q at level 1 — he pokes for free while you farm. Take last-hits from max range and eat nothing.

edits.before: Q-E already threatens the stun — most mids don't respect it at 2 and pay a Flash for the lesson.
edits.after: Still his range war: Arcanopulse and Eye of Destruction chip for free while QE is a level away. Farm.

edits.before: Full kit: W-slow into QE stun into Q again is a half-bar rotation. The lane is yours to bully from here.
edits.after: QE online flips it: dodge Shocking Orb and his poke never converts, while your stun starts a half-bar rotation.

edits.before: Splinter stacks build toward empowered Q — keep poking; every sphere thrown is scaling AND pressure at once.
edits.after: Splinter stacks build empowered Q — keep poking; his only kill tool is a 13s Shocking Orb, so dodging it keeps you free.

edits.before: Luden's spike: QE-stun into full rotation deletes squishies. Force the wave contact trades he cannot refuse.
edits.after: Luden's spike: QE-stun into full rotation deletes the escape-less Xerath whenever he steps up to touch a wave.

edits.before: Late Syndra is a one-button court-martial: flank, QE the carry, R the verdict. Spheres on the ground are sentences waiting.
edits.after: Late an immobile Xerath is the prime R target: flank, QE him, and your stun cancels his Rite of the Arcane channel outright.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Scatter the Weak has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Shocking Orb: 13s at rank 1, 11s max — his only CC; dodge it and the next dozen seconds of lane are yours. - Eye of Destruction cycles every 14-10s; sidestep the centre. - Your E cancels his Rite of the Arcane channel outright. R only when his orb is down.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: Spending E on chip-spacing and then eating Shocking Orb with nothing left to answer it — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: Two spheres near the wave make QE a point-and-click stun and feed R's sphere count — the bank is threat and execute ammo at once.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: With R down your execute is gone — past river you stand in 1050-range Shocking Orb territory with no wards and no answer left.
Xerath's Rite of the Arcane sieges from 5000 range but roots him in a channel — your E cancels it outright if he dares cast it inside stun range.
